event_text: The cyber incident is detected, Downing Street says, a day before DWP announces it
notes: The BBC reports the spokesperson saying it was detected "yesterday"; no time given.

event_text: DWP posts a notice on GOV.UK saying it has taken some online services offline as a precaution after identifying a cyber incident affecting its systems
notes: Time is the notice's publication time on GOV.UK.

event_text: Online systems for pensions, Universal Credit and PIP applications, and the Tell Us Once service, cannot be accessed, the BBC reports
The online systems for pensions, Universal Credit and PIP applications, and Tell Us Once, still cannot be accessed, the BBC reports
Downing Street says an investigation is looking at who is behind the incident and that there is currently no evidence of customer data loss, the BBC reports
notes: Time is the BBC live-page entry.

event_text: Some Universal Credit claimants tell the BBC their payments have not arrived
notes: Time is the BBC live-page entry.

event_text: The Work and Pensions Secretary calls the outage a "serious cyber incident" and says there is no evidence anyone's data has been compromised, the BBC reports
notes: Time is the BBC live-page entry.

event_text: Asked about claimants' missing payments, DWP repeats that regular payments are not affected and says anyone with a payment problem should call its benefit phoneline, the BBC reports
notes: Time is the BBC live-page entry.

event_text: DWP updates its GOV.UK notice: people who need help should call their usual benefit line
notes: Time is the notice's own update time.

event_text: DWP says nobody will be sanctioned if the cyber incident stopped them attending or updating their claim, the BBC reports
notes: Time is the BBC live-page entry.
